valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 25.76, price over EPS 24.10); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the balance-sheet multiples stand on FY2024

derived.enterpriseValueBasis: market cap + borrowings - cash, both from the balance sheet for FY2024
